ns2:course.label: Voice and Movement II
ns2:course.description: Further development of the interconnected vocal production and movement processes for the actor. Various exercised, conditioning, and training methods are used. Prerequisite: Enrollment limited to Theatre majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Enrollment limited to Theatre majors only.
